$comment: SUGGESTION REGISTER. Nothing here is implemented automatically. Each suggestion has a recommended path, the alternatives considered, the source that constrains it, and an explicit decision state. A human picks before any change ships.

suggestions.title: Lead the front page with products, not with the verification process
suggestions.problem: A buyer landing on a compliance dashboard reads a register, not a shop, and leaves.
suggestions.recommended_path: Front page is a publication layout: masthead, disclosure strip, a seasonal lead feature, a four-card product shelf, then guides. Dashboards move to the footer.
alternatives: Keep a dashboard as the front page (rejected: fails the shop test)
Split into two sites (rejected: splits ranking signals)
suggestions.success_measure: Outbound clicks per eligible session on the front page.

suggestions.title: Confirm link intent before publishing any outbound control
suggestions.problem: Four short links resolve to listings, but a redirect is evidence of what a link did, not proof of what the owner meant it to be.
suggestions.recommended_path: Publish the four observed products using the observed ASIN's canonical /dp/ URL plus the supplied tag. Keep intended_asin null until the owner confirms. Show the record publicly.
alternatives: Treat the redirect as the intended ASIN (rejected: merges evidence into intent)
Publish nothing until confirmation (rejected: leaves the site empty, and the observation is strong evidence)
suggestions.risk: Medium. If a redirect later changes, a published product page points at the wrong item. Mitigated by the dated observation record.
suggestions.success_measure: Five intended_asin fields filled from owner statements.

suggestions.title: Hold the unresolved fifth link rather than guess a product
suggestions.problem: One of five links returns a bot-check interstitial, then the Amazon homepage. A direct ASIN fetch finds no product.
suggestions.recommended_path: Publish a clearly labelled holding page that says the destination is unresolved and links to the Flagged for Review entry. Do not attach it to any product page.
alternatives: Guess the nearest matching air fryer (rejected: fabrication)
Silently drop it (rejected: hides a real defect from the owner)
suggestions.risk: Low. Worst case a placeholder is visible until the owner supplies the right link.
suggestions.success_measure: A corrected link replaces the holding page.

suggestions.title: Publish guides as product questions, not as buying-guide listicles
suggestions.problem: Generic 'best air fryer 2026' listicles compete with wirecutter-scale domains on day one and win nothing.
suggestions.recommended_path: Four narrow, question-shaped pieces that a comparison shopper actually types: basket vs. oven style, a capacity checklist, a cleanup and counter-space trade-off piece, and pre-purchase questions for multi-function appliances.
alternatives: Publish a single long listicle (rejected: no ranking foothold)
Publish 20 thin pages (rejected: dilutes the site and risks the original-content requirement)
suggestions.risk: Medium. The topics are editorial hypotheses, not validated demand. Measure before scaling.
suggestions.success_measure: Impressions and query data in Search Console, once connected.

suggestions.title: Count outbound clicks on our own origin, never by redirecting
suggestions.problem: Click measurement usually means routing the user through a tracker, which risks the redirecting-link and URL-obscuring rules.
suggestions.recommended_path: A fire-and-forget beacon on click to a write-only first-party endpoint. The anchor's real href is the Amazon URL. No redirect, no cloaking, no per-user identifier.
alternatives: Server-side 302 redirect (rejected: S08, S09)
Third-party analytics script (rejected: adds a data processor and a consent burden)
No measurement (rejected: the brief requires measurement)
suggestions.risk: Low technically; the endpoint must exist before counts are non-zero.
suggestions.success_measure: Non-zero recorded click events from real sessions.

suggestions.title: Ship the campaign ledger empty, with the columns defined in advance
suggestions.problem: A revenue table filled with estimates becomes a forecast nobody can audit.
suggestions.recommended_path: Define timestamp, source, channel, eligible sessions, clicks, reported orders. Leave every value empty. Add a row only from an authorized first-party report, with its provenance.
alternatives: Seed with illustrative numbers (rejected: indistinguishable from data)
Forecast revenue (rejected: the brief forbids it)
suggestions.risk: None. An empty table is honest.
suggestions.success_measure: First row added with a dated provenance note.

suggestions.title: Put a build gate in front of the disclosure and link rules
suggestions.problem: Disclosure placement and sponsored marking decay the moment a new page is added by hand.
suggestions.recommended_path: The build fails if any generated page lacks the disclosure strip, lacks rel=sponsored on an outbound Amazon link, or links to a page that does not exist.
alternatives: Manual review checklist (rejected: unenforceable at scale)
suggestions.risk: Low. A failing gate blocks deploy, which is the point.
suggestions.success_measure: Gate catches a deliberately broken page in a test.

suggestions.title: Give search engines exactly one canonical site
suggestions.problem: A repo can be published at several URLs; duplicated hosts split signals.
suggestions.recommended_path: One canonical base URL, self-referencing canonicals on every page, one sitemap.xml, one feed.xml, a robots.txt that points at the sitemap.
alternatives: Rely on search engines to pick a canonical (rejected: they often do not)
suggestions.success_measure: Sitemap submitted in Search Console with pages indexed.

suggestions.title: Do not display prices, star ratings, or review quotes
suggestions.problem: Prices and ratings are the two most tempting things to copy from a listing, and the two most constrained.
suggestions.recommended_path: Omit all three. State the constraint on the page instead, so a reader understands why a shop page has no price.
alternatives: Show a scraped price with a timestamp (rejected: S05)
Show ratings with an attribution note (rejected: S04)
suggestions.risk: Low commercially: a shop without prices converts worse.
suggestions.success_measure: Zero gate violations for price or rating content.

suggestions.title: Connect Search Console before writing guide five
suggestions.problem: Topic five would otherwise be picked on instinct.
suggestions.recommended_path: Verify the property, submit sitemap.xml, and wait for query data. Choose topic five from measured queries.
alternatives: Keep writing on instinct (rejected: unmeasurable)
suggestions.risk: Low. Requires the owner to hold the property's DNS or HTML verification token.
suggestions.success_measure: Search Console shows impressions for at least one guide.

suggestions.title: Defer all paid acquisition
suggestions.problem: Paid traffic looks like the fastest route to volume.
suggestions.recommended_path: Do not buy search or social traffic until the disqualification rules are read against the intended campaign. Both the Prohibited Paid Search Placement rule and the April 2026 paid-advertising exclusion bear on it.
alternatives: Run a small branded-display test now (rejected: the exclusion is broad, and a test on a disqualified channel teaches nothing)
suggestions.risk: None. This is a decision to wait.
suggestions.success_measure: A written paid-acquisition plan reviewed against S06, S07 and S16 before spend.

suggestions.title: Add a seasonal front-page feature slot
suggestions.problem: A static front page gives a returning reader no reason to return.
suggestions.recommended_path: One dated seasonal slot driven by a data field, so changing the season is a one-line data edit rather than a redesign.
alternatives: Hand-edit the hero each month (rejected: drifts and breaks the gate)
suggestions.risk: Low. Must not imply a promotion that has ended (S02, promotions clause).
suggestions.success_measure: Season field updated at least quarterly.

suggestions.title: Keep every dashboard reachable from the footer in one navigation group
suggestions.problem: Verification surfaces need to stay public without crowding the shop.
suggestions.recommended_path: A single 'Records' group in the footer listing every dashboard page.
alternatives: Top navigation (rejected: makes the site read like an audit)
Unlinked pages (rejected: unreachable for the owner)
suggestions.success_measure: Every dashboard page reachable in one click from any page footer.

suggestions.title: Publish a named author and an editorial policy
suggestions.problem: An authorless site reads as generated.
suggestions.recommended_path: A real byline with a real person's name and a short 'how we choose products' note. Blocked: no verifiable author identity was supplied.
alternatives: Invent a persona (rejected: fabrication and an FTC risk)
Use an organisation byline (partially done: 'the shopnow047c-20 desk')
suggestions.risk: Low. Requires one line of input from the owner.
suggestions.success_measure: A named human byline on each guide.

suggestions.title: Add a reader capture surface only after a privacy notice exists
suggestions.problem: Email capture is the standard next step for a publication, but it creates a data-processing obligation.
suggestions.recommended_path: Build the capture form only alongside a privacy notice that names the processor, the purpose, and the opt-out.
alternatives: Ship a mailto: link as a stopgap (rejected: still collects personal data without a notice)
Ship capture now (rejected: S24 and the Participation Requirements data-duty clause)
suggestions.risk: Medium. Needs a real mailing provider and a notice.
suggestions.success_measure: A published privacy notice precedes the first captured address.
